subject: Vendor login: intermittent session snapshot gap — NovaParts onboarding
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.p@novaparts.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble accessing supplier dashboard after invite

Hi Tessa,

We accepted the supplier portal invite yesterday but are hitting a strange problem when our procurement lead tries to view POs. After logging in they see the welcome page for a second and then the site reloads to the login screen with an error banner saying "session snapshot missing". It happens across Chrome and Edge and for two different NovaParts users.

Steps we took: accepted invite link, completed identity step, allowed 2FA prompt, entered OTP — then redirect to /dashboard shows for ~1s and we end up back at /login. No error code beyond the small banner. Screenshot attached.

We have a PO scheduled to be acknowledged today and it's blocking our AP team. Can you escalate?

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Procurement Manager — NovaParts
[signed]

[attachment: login-screenshot.png (image/png)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.p@novaparts.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Trouble accessing supplier dashboard after invite

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear repro steps and the screenshot. I'm copying Ben (SSO/runtime) and Kimberly (onboarding ops).

Quick checklist while we triage:
- Can you confirm whether the same users can access the portal from an incognito window?
- Do you have any corporate proxy/VPN enabled that might affect cookies?
- Approx local times for the two failed attempts (so we can correlate with logs): you gave yesterday — can you forward exact timestamps if possible.

Ben/Kim: initial hypothesis is a session-store handshake failure where the snapshot (prefix cache / session index) isn't persisted post-auth and the runtime rejects the session, forcing a redirect. Could be a cookie SameSite or path mismatch with the embedded Coupa iframe. If it helps, Sanjay attached a screenshot of the brief flash before redirect.

We'll check our gateway and session logs and involve Coupa support if we see protocol-level failures.

Action items: Ben to pull session logs + correlation id; Kim to validate invite link and metadata for NovaParts tenant; Tessa to coordinate with NovaParts for exact timestamps and confirm incognito/VPN checks.

Tessa Morgan
Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.p@novaparts.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Trouble accessing supplier dashboard after invite

Hi Tessa — quick update: we tried an incognito window and a different network; same behavior. Our timestamps are: 2027-09-03T16:42:11Z and 2027-09-03T16:55:02Z (both users). No VPN. I've attached the browser console capture and the Coupa session response header dump I could get from the network tab.

We also opened a ticket with Coupa (CS-987654) in case it's on their side. If you need a remote session tomorrow morning, I'm available.

Thanks,
Sanjay

[attachment: coupa-session-log.txt (text/plain)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.p@novaparts.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Coupa Support <support@coupa.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Trouble accessing supplier dashboard after invite

Thanks for the artifacts, Sanjay — very helpful. I pulled our gateway and runtime logs and correlated the two timestamps you provided. Observations:

- At both timestamps we see a successful POST to /auth/complete with a 200 and a session-id returned.
- Immediately after, an internal call to /session/snapshot returns 404 for the same session-id (this is our key clue).
- The call pattern suggests the auth token is valid but the session snapshot index lookup fails — causing the runtime to treat the session as uninitialized and redirect to login.

Next steps I'm taking now:
1) Pinned a debug build to log full snapshot-store keys for NovaParts tenant (will share correlation ids).
2) Reached out to Coupa with the session headers (cc'd) to see whether they are rewriting cookies or path attributes when embedded.
3) Temporary workaround: Kimberly, can we reissue the invite as a direct portal link (not embedded) and mark as "skip snapshot bind" so NovaParts users can access while we debug?

Sanjay, if you can confirm you'd accept a direct portal link for the next 24 hours we'll reissue and monitor. I expect this to be low-risk; it's only a routing adjustment.

Ben Carter
Platform Reliability — Redwood Inference

[Next update will include correlation ids and Coupa response]
